type Limits = { Pages: int; Objects: int; References: int; ReadBytes: int64; LogicalBytes: int64; Milliseconds: int }

let cases = ResizeArray<obj>()
let jsonOptions = JsonSerializerOptions(Constants.JsonSerializerOptions, WriteIndented = true, DefaultIgnoreCondition = Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.Never)
/// Writes standalone experiment evidence including explicit zero and null values.

/// Performs a bounded stream read with cancellation and a cumulative attempt byte budget.
let readBytes (stream: Stream) (token: CancellationToken) cap (consumed: int64 ref) =
    use output = new MemoryStream()
    let buffer = Array.zeroCreate<byte> 4096
    let mutable ended = false
    while not ended do
        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        let count = stream.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(), token).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        consumed.Value <- consumed.Value + int64 count
        if consumed.Value > cap then failwith "read-byte-cap"
        if count = 0 then ended <- true else output.Write(buffer, 0, count)
    output.ToArray()
/// Measures observed decoded bytes without inventing a retained expected hash or length.
let decodeOrphan cap (token: CancellationToken) (compressed: byte array) =
    use input = new MemoryStream(compressed)
    use gzip = new GZipStream(input, CompressionMode.Decompress)
    let consumed = ref 0L
    let bytes = readBytes gzip token cap consumed
    let text = UTF8Encoding(false, true).GetString bytes
    int64 bytes.Length, text

/// Reads an existing Cosmos event source afresh, with actual provider continuation and bounded response streams.
let observeEvents (source: Container) repositoryId current (cap: Limits) =
    let started = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
    let mutable pages, objects, references = 0, 0, 0
    let consumed = ref 0L
    let distinct = Dictionary<Guid,TextContent>()
    let mutable detail = ""
    let mutable status = "enumeration-exhausted-declarations"
    let mutable bytes = Nullable<int64>()
    use deadline = new CancellationTokenSource(cap.Milliseconds)
    if cap.Milliseconds = 0 then deadline.Cancel()
    try
        deadline.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        let query = QueryDefinition("SELECT c.State FROM c WHERE c.GrainType = @grain AND c.PartitionKey = @repo").WithParameter("@grain", Grace.Actors.Constants.StateName.WorkItem).WithParameter("@repo", string repositoryId)
        use iterator = source.GetItemQueryStreamIterator(query, requestOptions = QueryRequestOptions(PartitionKey = PartitionKey(string repositoryId), MaxItemCount = 2))
        while iterator.HasMoreResults do
            if pages >= cap.Pages then failwith "page-cap"
            use page = iterator.ReadNextAsync(deadline.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            page.EnsureSuccessStatusCode() |> ignore
            pages <- pages + 1
            let payload = readBytes page.Content deadline.Token cap.ReadBytes consumed
            use document = JsonDocument.Parse payload
            for row in document.RootElement.GetProperty("Documents").EnumerateArray() do
                objects <- objects + 1
                if objects > cap.Objects then failwith "object-cap"
                let stream = deserialize<WorkItemEvent array> (row.GetProperty("State").GetRawText())
                let state = stream |> Array.fold (fun s e -> WorkItemState.UpdateState e s) WorkItemState.Default
                if state.WorkItem.RepositoryId <> repositoryId then failwith "scope-mismatch"
                let descriptions =
                    if current then [|state.Description|]
                    else stream |> Array.choose (fun e -> match e.Event with Created(_,_,_,_,_,_,desc) -> Some desc | DescriptionSet desc | DescriptionCleared desc -> Some(Some desc) | _ -> None)
                for description in descriptions do
                    for desc in Option.toArray description do
                        for reference in Option.toArray desc.TextContent do
                            references <- references + 1
                            if references > cap.References then failwith "reference-cap"
                            match distinct.TryGetValue reference.TextContentId with
                            | true, prior when prior <> reference -> failwith "conflicting-reference"
                            | _ -> distinct[reference.TextContentId] <- reference
                if (distinct.Values |> Seq.sumBy _.Utf8ByteLength) > cap.LogicalBytes then failwith "logical-byte-cap"
        bytes <- Nullable(distinct.Values |> Seq.sumBy _.Utf8ByteLength)
    with ex -> status <- "incomplete"; detail <- ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message
    { Status = status; Bytes = bytes; Pages = pages; Objects = objects; References = references; ReadBytes = consumed.Value; Started = started; Finished = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow; Detail = detail; Rows = if bytes.HasValue then distinct.Values |> Seq.map box |> Seq.toArray else [||] }

/// Enumerates only an existing repository's TextContent prefix and optionally downloads each observed object.
let observeBlobs (source: BlobContainerClient) measure (expected: Map<Guid,TextContent>) (cap: Limits) =
    let started = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
    let mutable pages, objects, references = 0, 0, 0
    let consumed = ref 0L
    let rows = ResizeArray<obj>()
    let mutable total = 0L
    let mutable status = if measure then "enumeration-exhausted-observed-bytes" else "enumeration-exhausted-inventory"
    let mutable detail = ""
    let mutable bytes = Nullable<int64>()
    use deadline = new CancellationTokenSource(cap.Milliseconds)
    if cap.Milliseconds = 0 then deadline.Cancel()
    try
        deadline.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        let listing = source.GetBlobsAsync(BlobTraits.None, BlobStates.None, prefix = "text-content/", cancellationToken = deadline.Token).AsPages(pageSizeHint = Nullable 2).GetAsyncEnumerator(deadline.Token)
        try
            let mutable ended = false
            while not ended do
                if pages >= cap.Pages then failwith "page-cap"
                if listing.MoveNextAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult() then
                    pages <- pages + 1
                    for item in listing.Current.Values do
                        objects <- objects + 1
                        if objects > cap.Objects then failwith "object-cap"
                        let id = Guid.ParseExact(item.Name.Substring("text-content/".Length), "N")
                        let mutable logical = Nullable<int64>()
                        let mutable verification = "not-downloaded"
                        if measure then
                            use download = source.GetBlobClient(item.Name).DownloadStreaming(cancellationToken = deadline.Token).Value
                            let payload = readBytes download.Content deadline.Token cap.ReadBytes consumed
                            match Map.tryFind id expected with
                            | Some reference ->
                                references <- references + 1
                                if references > cap.References then failwith "reference-cap"
                                use stream = new MemoryStream(payload)
                                match TextContentStorage.verifyCompressedText 65536 reference stream with
                                | Ok text -> logical <- Nullable(int64 (Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount text)); verification <- "verified-retained-reference"
                                | Error error -> failwith error
                            | None ->
                                let length, _ = decodeOrphan (min 262144L (cap.LogicalBytes - total)) deadline.Token payload
                                logical <- Nullable length
                                verification <- "observed-decompression-only-no-retained-expected-hash-or-length"
                            total <- total + logical.Value
                            if total > cap.LogicalBytes then failwith "logical-byte-cap"
                        rows.Add(box {| Id = id; Name = item.Name; CompressedBytes = item.Properties.ContentLength; LogicalBytes = logical; Verification = verification |})
                    if String.IsNullOrEmpty listing.Current.ContinuationToken then ended <- true
                else ended <- true
        finally listing.DisposeAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        if measure then bytes <- Nullable total
    with ex -> status <- "incomplete"; detail <- ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message
    { Status = status; Bytes = bytes; Pages = pages; Objects = objects; References = references; ReadBytes = consumed.Value; Started = started; Finished = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow; Detail = detail; Rows = if status = "incomplete" then [||] else rows.ToArray() }

let observeReferenced (cap: Limits) =

    let mutable total = 0L
    let mutable bytes = Nullable<int64>()

            if objects > cap.Objects || objects > cap.References then failwith "reference-object-cap"
            use download = container.GetBlobClient(StorageKeys.textContentObjectKey id).DownloadStreaming(cancellationToken = deadline.Token).Value

            | Ok _ -> total <- total + reference.Utf8ByteLength
            if total > cap.LogicalBytes then failwith "logical-byte-cap"
        bytes <- Nullable total
    with ex -> status <- "incomplete"; detail <- ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message
